integrity: The universal real-parameter result follows from an explicit orthogonal decomposition and PBH proof; rational rank calculations are supplementary, not the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact fixed-graph fixed-weight family result; one exceptional positive edge only. No claim for higher-dimensional cubes, simultaneous shared controls, or other edge perturbations. Literature priority is provisional pending independent review. Exact controllability does not imply well-conditioned or low-energy actuation near the homogeneous limit.
title: Parity-rigid two-actuator control of a three-cube with one detuned edge
